sentences.en: As far housing goes, it is very poor in Japan.
sentences.zh: 关于住房方面，日本的情况非常糟糕。

sentences.en: The government made no move to solve the housing problem.
sentences.zh: 政府没有采取任何措施来解决住房问题。

sentences.en: It seems that Mr Hatoyama is living in company housing.
sentences.zh: 看来Hatoyama先生住在公司提供的宿舍里。

senses.zh: 房屋；住房供给；[机] 外壳；遮盖物；机器等的防护外壳或外罩
